name: Ransomware Resilience Webinar: Building & Testing Your Incident Response Plan
description:

Join us to understand how organizations can strengthen their response plans, identify common preparedness gaps, and explore how Cisco security capabilities can support faster detection, investigation, and containment.

**Get Your Free Seat Now -** **[Link](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/ransomware-resilience-incident-response-plan-with-cisco?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=cisco_fy26_q4&utm_content=organic_listing)**

⏰ **12:00 PM ET**
🎟️ **Complimentary Online Session**

**What You’ll Explore**

* Building and validating an incident response plan
* Common ransomware preparedness gaps
* Detection across endpoint, network, and identity
* Cisco security capabilities for threat response
* Key stages of the incident response lifecycle
* Cybersecurity skills and learning pathways

**Who Should Attend?**
Open to **IT and cybersecurity professionals, technical teams, managers, business leaders, students, and anyone interested in strengthening cybersecurity knowledge and preparedness.**

Join us this **Cybersecurity Awareness Month** and take a practical step toward stronger cyber resilience.
